scope: Root independent raw SSE IDs/native outcomes, real runtime correlation+launch-thread annotations, GPU phase sums and interval unions; no GPU work
source_parser_review: Observer wraps original Python calls exactly once, reads CPU token lists/tensor metadata, no explicit tensor-value copies or GPU synchronization.
Native/client exact IDs are extracted from actual raw SSE packet ids, not time inference.
GPU phases match runtime launch thread and enclosing annotations; exact phase kernel sums independently reproduced.
Worker measured_tpot_tail_request uses nearest-rank upper contributor, not the official linear-interpolated P95. Do not present its per-request stage values as exact P95 decomposition.
limitations: Instrumented replay timings are excluded from performance qualification.
Shared batch intervals are not exclusive request GPU charges or a dependency DAG.
Only about64 scheduler calls captured; full28-job native/client histories do not imply complete GPU coverage for each tail.
C8 offered concurrency still reaches at most6 native active decode requests under this R6 service; admission queue matters.
FP8 GEMM dominance is kernel time attribution, not a measured bandwidth/compute roofline. NCU counters unavailable.
Replay BF16 GEMMs are not exclusively attributed to LM head from capture-time Python annotations.
Native internal MTP output_ids end at512..516 while client output is512. Native progress sums/coverage may include terminal overshoot and are not exact delivered-output token accounting.
